title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1991-09-21
lineage: 16 bit – 48kHz DAT Master > TASCAM DA-20 (SPDIF out) -> LynxTWO-B Audio Reference Interface (SPDIF in) -> Wavelab 6.0 (Weiss Saracon for 16 BIT – 44.1kHz SRC and POWR-3 Dither)
source: Set 1 Clone of Master DAT, Set 2 Master DAT Set 1 Clone of Master DAT Recording Equipment: B&K 4011 110º ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD D-10 Pro Recording Location: FOB

ai_review.summary: Full, balanced soundboard capture of a quintessential Saturday show with standout performances of Cassidy, Tom Thumb and an exhilarating second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its full, balanced mix – Phil’s bass sits dead‑center while the rest of the band is nicely spread.  The first set rolls at a relaxed pace before building into a powerful mid‑set, and the second set is described as “sparkly” with the band firing on all cylinders.  Overall both the performance and the tape quality earn high marks.

ai_rating.rationale: The single detailed 5‑star review highlights an excellent performance and a superb soundboard recording, leading to a near‑top rating despite limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Full and balanced mix; Phil’s bass is dead‑center with the rest of the band spread out appropriately. No audible flaws or drop‑outs mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set takes its sweet time and builds gradually; second set is described as sparkly and highly engaging, delivering a classic Saturday‑night arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Positive remarks about his “follow‑up” after the opening song and his improvisational choices (e.g., Fire out of Slipknot).
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for being dead‑center in the mix, indicating a strong bass presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Bruce’s extroverted playing is highlighted as adding excitement, especially in the second set.
